answer: By binding each agent identity to a bonded validator slot whose quorum intersection is verified through a trellis of temporally ordered TLA+ safety proofs, the economy forces every new participant to cross a cryptographic bridge that costs real capital rather than a free keypair. Sybil clusters attempting to flood the river of incoming identities must split stake across. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
